opening.title: Crypto Content Creator
opening.summary: Make Nasfam Pay the most watched crypto brand in Nigeria.
opening.about: You ship short-form video every day that a real trader would stop scrolling for. TikTok first, repurposed to Reels and X. You shoot it, you cut it, you write the hook.
requirements: You already trade or actively use crypto. This one is not learnable in time.
Comfortable on camera AND able to make faceless content (screen recording, voiceover).
You edit your own short-form to a publishable standard.
You understand Solana, DEX and memecoin culture from the inside.
Based in Nigeria, with your own phone and laptop.
niceToHave: You have grown an account from near-zero and can show the numbers.
Fluent with AI tools for scripting, voiceover, b-roll and repurposing.
Hausa, Yoruba or Igbo for regional cuts.
success: Day 30: 20+ videos shipped, brand voice settled, two format ideas tested.
Day 60: a repeatable format that beats your own baseline.
Day 90: signups we can trace back to organic content.
